initialExam.title: REET 2026 (Rajasthan Eligibility Exam for Teachers)
initialExam.description: Rajasthan Eligibility Examination for Teachers for Level 1 (Class 1-5) and Level 2 (Class 6-8) teacher posts in Rajasthan government schools.
initialExam.eligibility: D.El.Ed/B.El.Ed for Level 1; B.Ed for Level 2
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching degree/diploma as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Level 1: Child Development, Language I (Hindi), Language II (English), Math, EVS. Level 2: Child Development, Languages, Math/Science or Social Studies.
initialExam.examPattern: Level 1: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Level 2: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: REET Qualification → Level 1/2 Recruitment by Rajasthan Education Department
initialExam.jobRole: Third Grade Teacher in Rajasthan government schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade III Teacher → Grade II → Grade I → Head Master.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit reetbser.com 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
